info.title: SecureTravels CRM API
info.description: Phase 1 — Core CRM. Leads, bookings (FIXED_BATCH / CUSTOM_FIT), payments, operations.

get.summary: Per-traveller checklist with required/verified items and %

put.summary: Mark checklist items (VERIFIED is the green state; demote allowed)

post.description: Public endpoint for the website enquiry form. Signature header X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed over the raw body with the shared webhook secret.

201.description: Lead created; owner assigned; 5-min call task scheduled

get.summary: List vendors (optional category filter; active by default)
List trips (default: active only, for filters/pickers)
List batches of a trip

post.summary: Create a departure batch on a FIXED_BATCH trip
Generate a season of departure batches from a recurrence rule
post.description: Module 3. Expands the rule to concrete dates and creates one batch per date in a single transaction. Dates that already have a batch are reported in skippedDates rather than failing the run, so an existing season can be extended.

get.summary: List payment lines (scoped; booking / status / type filters)

post.summary: Record a payment line (advance / balance / full) against a booking
Mark the trip sheet as generated (regenerating refreshes the timestamp)
Append a timestamped note to the handoff

get.summary: List leads (filtered; SALES/OPS see only their own)

post.summary: Request a presigned S3 PUT upload URL for a traveller document
Confirm an upload: records the object and links it to the checklist

get.summary: Check whether the batch currently passes the READY_FOR_DEPARTURE gate

post.summary: Mark the batch READY_FOR_DEPARTURE (409 if compliance is below the gate)

get.summary: List bookings (SALES see only their own; filters optional)

post.summary: Create a booking (FIXED_BATCH holds seats; CUSTOM_FIT is private)

get.summary: Get a vendor
Get a trip with its departure batches

patch.summary: Advance a payment line: PENDING -> PARTIAL/COMPLETED/CANCELLED, PARTIAL -> COMPLETED/REFUNDED, COMPLETED -> REFUNDED (paidAt required for COMPLETED)
Update arrangements: hotel / transport status, guide, driver

get.summary: Get one lead

patch.summary: Edit lead fields (heat recomputed, per-field audit)
Change lead status (audited; LOST requires lostReason)

get.summary: Customer detail incl. trip history + marketing flags

patch.summary: Update marketing flags: suggest-offer, remarketing tags, opt-in, notes
Advance a booking: QUOTATION -> CONFIRMED (seats), -> CANCELLED (seats released), CONFIRMED -> COMPLETED

get.summary: List follow-up tasks (SALES see own; managers see all)
Receivable statement for a booking (gross, net, applied, balance)
List ops handoffs (SALES see only their own bookings' handoffs; filters optional)
Get one ops handoff (booking context, arrangements, receivable status, notes)
My notification feed (newest first)
Lead activity timeline (from audit_log)
List documents for a traveller (compliance uploads)
List customers — search by name/mobile/email
Batch compliance board (confirmed bookings only)
Get a booking with travellers
Current authenticated user
